notes.title: Update 0.6 is now live!
notes.content:
Howdy Astronauts!

Update 0.6 is now here! (finally) and contains the following changes:
- A new belt with its own biomes, new debris, wreckages, etc.
- 10 new blueprints
- 19 new recipes
- 10 new plantable foods - including 6 mushrooms
- 26 new items
- Airlocks! Create an interior to your ship and breathe!
- Foods can now be eaten without a SIP (only inside airlocks)
- New status effects
- New debris type (Liquid covered scraps)
- Hydrogen thrusters (reusable)
- Anything debris can now be hit with the crowbar to move it.
- Added Vsync button in main menu
- Fixed control binds not saving in the in-game menu
- Fixed many other things I've forgotten to write down over the past few months.

Hopefully the size of this update helps with the fact it's taken so long to make. I'll be keeping a close eye on the various feedback avenues and there's likely to be some patches out over the next few weeks to fix anything that inevitably comes up.

There's a few smaller changes I want to make such as some more furnishing blueprints and a new vertical thruster. But this update was just getting bigger and bigger and it was time to let everyone play it. You'll see these changes appear in 0.6.1.


Going forward:
There's some changes to the "branding" of the game. Most importantly, I'm going to start transitioning from the domain lifenotsupported.com to the company domain yetibytes.com. This mostly affects the support email address which is now contact@yetibytes.com. You'll also see the yetibytes logo on the splash screen when the game loads up and on the "publisher" page here on steam.

I am going to have to work on some sort of new game alongside the Life Not Supported updates from now on due to the fact the game is no longer providing enough to pay rent (and hasn't for some time). Ever since the review dip into mixed a few months ago, very few people are giving LNS a go. [b]This does not mean I'm giving up on LNS[/b], just that I'll be doing more. You can get notified when the next games' store page goes live by following the "publisher page" [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/samstubbings]here.[/url]

As always, thank you for playing my game and especially for so long!
Sam :)

notes.title: Upcoming content: Airlocks, Farming overhaul, & Gamma belt!
notes.content:
Howdy Astronauts!

Update 0.6 has been taking some time to make, but that's ok! I want the Gamma belt update to be a substantial addition to the game instead of just another small update.

[h2]Gamma belt[/h2]
So you've explored the Alpha Belt, with its planetary surveying wreckages, and the dense, icy particle field of the Beta Belt, scattered with data-relaying wreckages. It'll soon be time to venture into the Gamma Belt, where seed vaults were stored, which were ready for deployment following what would have been the terraforming stage. These vaults are passcode protected, so you'll have to do some digging around to get inside (or just hit the keypad [b][i]really hard[/i][/b] and hotwire the circuits). Speaking of seed vaults:

[h2]Farming overhaul[/h2]
It's looking like there'll be [b]11[/b] new types of plant to grow in Update 0.6. This will include some new plants for eating such as carrots, and some fungi to craft medicine. There'll also be new status effects that different foods can give you, such as feeling energised, well fed, and poisoned.

[h2]Airlocks (finally)[/h2]
So for the past few weeks I've been getting airlocks to work reliably with the game's building system. You'll be able to create your own airlocks along with finding some wreckages with intact airlocks. While in an airlock, you can breathe without depleting your O2, and your oxygen storage will gradually refill. This also allows for an upgraded set of blueprints that will no longer need oxygen tanks swapping out.

Thank you for checking out my game,
Sam ːsteamthumbsupː

Thank you for trying out my game and sticking around for a whole year! Here's to many more!
Sam :)

notes.title: 0.4.3 Update: New Biome, Wreckage, Disaster, Blueprint, Popups & Death rework
notes.content:
Howdy Astronauts!

Today's content update (0.4.3) is released and changes the following:
- Adds a new biome "Obliteration" that can spawn in the Alpha belt. It comes in two sub-variants - "sparse" and "dense" and contains large debris that be crowbarred to gather large quantities of scrap.
- Wreckages are now biome dependant. The previous 3 wreckages can be found in the default "Scraplands" biome, with a new wreckage introduced specifically for Obliteration.
- New Biome generation system, biomes now weave into each other. This addition will become more apparent and useful with the 0.5 update coming in November.
- Adds a new disaster! The "Dust Storm" will distrupt beacon signals as well as violently move ships around. Remember to stay tethered, or you could get lost.
- Reworked how death works. Instead of respawning near-ish to your ship, you now spawn in a nearby cyrogenics pod as a new survivor. You must follow the pings of the previous attempt to recover their items. You also gain the "Cryo-metabolism" status effect for several minutes - freezing your hunger and thirst depletion as you thaw.
- Added a liquid container blueprint. Can store up to 5 portions of liquid (including hydroponic solution). This blueprint interacts with the "shift-click" shortcuts feature that all other storage blueprints use.
- Adds new Ice debris variants.
- Adds a new info popup system. This will aid newer players when at low o2, or unsure why they are on fire.
- Added a backup feature, you now have automatic backups for the most recent 6 play sessions per save.
- Fixed space pirate achievement to not trigger on tutorial ships.
- Fixed bug where placing a blueprint whilst dying broke the UI.
- Increased % of words translated.
- Fixed crossbar crosshair freezing mid animation if held item was switched.
- Fixed ships "yeeting" when colliding into tutorial ships.
- Optimised ship loading and saving - no more freezing when a new ship spawns!
- Fixed bug where glass would only show in one direction.
- Fixed bug where refilling hydroponics would only allow for 1 more growth.
- You can now click the countdown in the main menu to open up the roadmap.
- Improved tutorial & added contingencies for players ignoring the tutorial.
- Fixed various soft-locking bugs.
- Fixed other minor bugs (which I've forgotten to write down).

As always, thank you for playing my game! I'm going to take this week to further improve the biome generation and fix any issues that you may find. Please use F8 to report any problems and I'll try and get it sorted asap.

Next up: Update 0.5 which will contain a ship movement overhaul, ship docking, and most importantly...
...a brand new belt to explore!

~ Sam :)

notes.title: Upcoming Content, FAQs & Similar Games?
notes.content:
Howdy Astronauts!

[i]Just a quick reminder before I start, new content in the game is unlocked from finding computers in ship wreckages. It is not unlocked by default![/i]

[h2]Upcoming content & Early Access so far[/h2]
So, Early Access came out 3 days ago and within the next week or so there'll be a content patch. It will contain some of the content I couldn't get ready in time for the Early Access release such as the wiring tool and solar panels, but also contain some new craftable items such as the SIP (medicine). Overall, after this next update there'll be double the amount of blueprints that there were pre-launch at 28 blueprints.

Also, within this first 72 hour period, 3 patches have been released fixing the following:
- Fixes item pickup glitch
- Fixes corpse's in co-op being lootablemany times
- Fixes being locked out of save files
- Fixes ships not appearing in co-op
- Many other co-op bugs that stemmed from previous bugs
- A new alert to let you know when you're getting too close to the planet (with enough time to react before fire).
- Balanced potato spawn rates
- Fixed some translation errors
- Reordered blueprint unlocks, pulled forwards more useful blueprint and pushed back more cosmetic ones.
- Added visual guidance on how to drop items
- Removed "Rotate" prompt from blueprint that can't rotate
- Fixed Floor-edges remaining after crowbarring the floor
- Display settings now show the refresh rate
- Fixed UI bug with tooltips on crafting bench
- Fixed keybinds not saving when altered in-game
- Fixed UI scaling on ultrawide monitors
- Fixed some minor co-op issues
- Corpses can now be detected from up to 4,000M away
- Ship movement despawns outside of the chunk spawning radius. So it won't fly off forever when you die.

Please keep reporting any issues and suggestions using F8 in-game. I've been getting reports in game asking 'How do you do X' which as there's no way to directly contact a sender of a report, I've made a quick FAQ later in this post with the common questions.

[h2]"Raft-like in Space" bundle[/h2]
The developer behind Remains, the developer behind Drift, and I have come together to create a bundle of similar games. All the raft-likes in space on steam (that I'm aware of) in one place, with an extra 10% off summer sale prices! Check it out if you're waiting for more updates or just want to see different takes on a similar theme :)

[h2]Some FAQs from Steam Forums, Discord, Emails & ingame reports:[/h2]
[b]Where's the crowbar/tape?[/b]
[i]The crowbar is located along the white pillar to in the centre of the starting ship, the duct tape can be found next to the spare space suits. Still having trouble? Don't worry, the game will automatically give you these items if you fly too far away from the starting wreckage![/i]

[b]Why the **** am I on fire?[/b]
[i]You're too close to the planet! I've updated the game to communicate this better but turn the ship around and head back into the alpha belt. You can check your coordinates, belt, & biome using F3.[/i]

[b]Why can't I find any potatoes?[/b]
[i]They can be found in white food boxes in ship wreckages, this is different from pre-early access versions. The recent patch 0.4.0.47 fixed spawn rates if you were having problems with this beforehand.[/i]

[b]How do I play Co-op?[/b]
[i]The Host must enter a co-op world via the main menu. Once in-game, the host can invite their friends via the steam friend menu (easily accessed through the steam overlay).[/i]

[b]Can I make an air lock?[/b]
[i]Not currently, air locked building will be added in the 0.6 Plantlife update.[/i]

[b]How to progress? (Where to find computers to unlock new blueprints & recipes)[/b]
[i]Ship computers can be found on wreckages found throughout the alpha belt (the default debris belt), if you haven't found one yet - keep using your trusty air thruster![/i]

[b]I've lost my dead body and all my loot, how can I get it back?[/b]
[i]You can find your corpse & loot it! As of patch 0.4.0.48 loaded chunks with corpses remain loaded so you can always detect their signal.

Also, you respawn with your tape & new crowbars can be found at wreckages worst case![/i]

[b]"I keep losing my ship" or similar[/b]
[i]I find the best way to not lose my ship is to use an air thruster along with an tether anchor. However, stopping the ship completely at night then staying in range of your high powered torches also works well.

If your ship flies away from you outside of simulation distance, all thrusters will now turn off (as of patch 0.4.0.48).[/i]

[b]Why aren't the translations in my language correct?[/b]
[i]English, German, Turkish, Chinese, (and soon Korean) have all been translated by community translators. The rest have been done via automated tool. If you find anything that looks incorrect, or would like to proofread the current translation, please get in touch![/i]




As always, thank you for sticking around and giving my game a go. If you have any questions, feedback, or bug reports about LNS please let me know!
Sam :)

notes.title: Playtest out now!
notes.content:
Howdy Astronauts!

The playtest for V0.03.1 is now out to everyone! Just click the 'Request Access' button on the storepage to be automatically added to the playtest list. If you've played the demo version previously [i]you should be able to use the same save games[/i] but I [b]recommend starting a new game[/b] to try out the new balancing of the early-game.

There a quite a few changes to this version of the game, from taking in feedback from the demo version and the helpful people at G.Round. For example, to craft items for your inventory you must use the crafting table now instead of pressing C. [i]You can no longer consume items just by right clicking[/i] you must instead put it into a S.I.P [i](Spacesuit Ingestional Pipe)[/i] Container with water to transfer it into your spacesuit. Also, blueprints now have limited oxygen and power supply to maintain. There will be automated systems in place to satisfy these later in the games development (such as the inclusion of solar panels, and a wiring tool).

A few other changes to note:
- Day/Night cycle, adequate lighting is now a must at night.
- Overhaul of ship movement, no longer will you drift in one direction for no reason - you must use your air tank thrusters to navigate orbit.
- Vertical thrusters (it's about time)
- Occasional asteroid storms, these are still early in development but are a start of the random events that the game will have.
- Occasional satellite structures, use the computers on these to unlock new blueprints (you can also build from these abandoned structures).
- More in-game music
- Many bugs have been fixed, although I'm sure there's plenty more to come


If you've played this new version and would like to fill out the playtest questionnaire, you can find it here https://forms.gle/83mw51NK2aBxt7sn6

As always, please feel free to leave feedback on the Steam Forums, the Discord Server, or just email me at contact@lifenotsupported.com

Thank you for giving LNS a go!
Sam Stubbings :)

notes.title: February '23 Dev Blog: Crowbar, Tether, and Demo Fixes
notes.content:
Howdy Astronauts!

As this Dev Blog goes out an update for the demo is now out, this now hopefully brings this new multiplayer re-write of the game back in line with the content level of the 2022 singleplayer version. 

The crowbar has been reimplemented for the new version of the game. As before, you can use the crowbar to:
[list]
[*] Remove completed blueprints from your ship (any storage items will drop their stored items)
[*] Remove floors & walls from your ship (any further disconnections will also be destroyed)
[*] Pry useful resources from larger debris items (currently only 1 large scrap debris type in the demo)
[/list]

The tether has also been reimplemented for the new version of the game. The new changes to the tether include:
[list]
[*] Change of button to prevent accidental incomplete blueprint deletion (rebind for this button coming soon).
[*] Better & optimised distance calculations
[*] Saving/Loading support. You will remain attached through play sessions. Also, if a non-host player saves attached to a tether, they will spawn into the game attached to the same ship and in a nearby location. (use this to not get lost if your not the host!)
[*] Retracting the tether now also works at any ship speed (finally!)
[/list]

There's also been some *interesting* issues found with this new demo version. most of which have been fixed. If you're still experiencing issues and haven't already, please send an email to [b]contact@lifenotsupported.com [/b]with details of your problem. The addition of the player log and save game data can also be useful [i](found in AppData/LocalLow/Stubbings/LifeNotSupported/player.log and AppData/LocalLow/Stubbings/LifeNotSupported/saves/SAVE-GAME-NAME/)[/i]. I'm also active on the forums and the discord so feel free to use them to :)

The trello roadmap is also always being altered as I continue working on the demo and can be found at https://trello.com/b/gCLQveU4/life-not-supported-roadmap

The plan going forward for this month is to continue polishing this demo version of the game, only then I can start adding the content for the 'real' game and start running playtesting through the Steam Playtest feature. 

As always, thank you for sticking around and giving the current version of the game a try!
Sam :)
